[[File:Alderaanexplosion.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Alderaan is destroyed by the Death Star]]
'''Mundicide''' was the destruction of a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] or similar celestial object. Various degrees of mundicide occurred throughout history, caused by such things as [[Supernova/Legends|supernovae]], [[Superlaser/Legends|superlasers]] such as the [[Galaxy Gun]] or the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Stars]], gravitational weaponry such as [[Centerpoint Station]], or other [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapons]]. Some planets, while not completely destroyed, were rendered uninhabitable, such as [[Caamas/Legends|Caamas]] and [[Uphrades]]. The deliberate destruction of a planet, such as the [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|Destruction of Alderaan]], was sometimes comparable to [[speciecide]] due to wiping out a significant portion of the planet's population.

==Completely destroyed==
===Destroyed by solar expansions, solar explosions, or [[Supernova/Legends|supernovae]]===
*The four innermost planets in the [[Carosus system]], including [[Carosi IV]]&mdash;circa [[200 BBY/Legends|200 BBY]]&mdash;Destroyed during the expansion of the [[Carosus system|system's]] star, [[Carosi]]
*[[Clak'dor I]]&mdash;circa [[8000 BBY]]&mdash;Destroyed during the expansion of the [[Colu system|system's]] star, [[Colu/Legends|Colu]]
*[[Demophon]], [[Derr]], [[Enarc (Demophon system)|Enarc]], [[Jatee]], and [[Zenobah]]&mdash;circa [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]&mdash;Destroyed when the [[Demophon system/Legends|Demophon system's]] [[Demophon (star)|sun]] naturally went [[Supernova/Legends|supernova]]
*[[Flankers]]&mdash;Destroyed sometime after [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] when its sun exploded
*[[Kashi]]&mdash;circa [[25,000 BBY/Legends|25,000 BBY]]&mdash;Destroyed when its system's star suddenly went supernova
*[[Mindor/Legends|Mindor]]&mdash;Destroyed by solar flares caused by the [[Gravity mine/Legends|Gravity mine]] falling into the system's star, [[Taspan]], See [[Battle of Mindor]]
*[[Ryyk]]&mdash;circa [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]]&mdash;Destroyed by supernova
*[[Shadda-Bi-Boran/Legends|Shadda-Bi-Boran]]&mdash;[[38 BBY/Legends|38 BBY]]&mdash;Destroyed when its sun went supernova
*[[Tililix]]&mdash;[[100 BBY/Legends|100 BBY]]&mdash;Destroyed when its sun went supernova.
*[[Worxer]]&mdash;[[232 BBY/Legends|232 BBY]]&mdash;Destroyed when its sun went supernova

====Other superweapons====
*[[Vultar]]. ([[4250 BBY]]) Destroyed by the [[Cosmic Turbine]]. See the [[Vultar Cataclysm]] for more detail.
*[[Malachor V]]. ([[3951 BBY]]) Destroyed by the [[Mass Shadow Generator/Legends|Mass Shadow Generator]]. See [[Battle of Malachor]] for more detail.

*[[Aeten II/Legends|Aeten II]]. Destroyed by the [[Tarkin (superweapon)|''Tarkin'']] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], following the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]].
*[[Helska IV]]. ([[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]]) Core is frozen and shattered by [[Shieldship]]s.

==Rendered uninhabitable==
===Bombardment by Jedi, Sith, Imperial, Republic, or other non-Yuuzhan-Vong forces===
*[[Caamas/Legends|Caamas]]&mdash;[[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]&mdash;Bombarded by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], with help of the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothans]]
*[[Callos]]&mdash;[[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]]&mdash;Bombarded by the Galactic Empire; during the bombardment, [[Black Eight Squadron]] was ordered by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] to destroy the [[Callos planetary reactor]]; ecosystem destroyed, the planet was no longer inhabited due to sub-freezing climate
*[[Dac/Legends|Dac]]&mdash;[[137 ABY]]&mdash; oceans poisoned by the [[One Sith]].
*[[Da Soocha]]&mdash;[[137 ABY]]&mdash; oceans poisoned by the [[One Sith]].
*[[Dankayo/Legends|Dankayo]]&mdash;subject to [[Base Delta Zero/Legends|Base Delta Zero]] bombardment by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]
*[[Duro/Legends|Duro]]&mdash;surface was bombarded sometime after [[3963 BBY]] by the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] during their [[Mandalorian Wars|invasion]] and in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]] by the [[Invisible Hand/Legends|''Invisible Hand'']] and the rest of Grievous' fleet, both times causing toxic chemicals from industrial areas on the surface to contaminate the entire planet's ecosystem.
*[[Hathrox III]]&mdash;c. [[1196 BBY]]&mdash;Population destroyed by a biological weapon in a [[Hathrox III civil war|civil war]]; planet rendered uninhabitable.
*[[Humbarine/Legends|Humbarine]]&mdash;Depopulated and crust melted by orbital bombardment performed by [[Invisible Hand/Legends|''Invisible Hand'']]
*[[Kalaan/Legends|Kalaan]]&mdash;[[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]]&mdash;subject to orbital bombardment by Empire
*[[Katarr/Legends|Katarr]]&mdash;[[3952 BBY]]&mdash;Was rendered uninhabitable when [[Darth Nihilus]] [[Conclave at Katarr|consumed all life]] on the planet.
*[[Osara Mundicide]]&mdash;between [[10,000 BBY|10,000]] and [[9400s BBY|9400 BBY]]&mdash; [[Mass-driver cannon/Legends|Mass driver]] bombardment in the [[Tenth Alsakan Conflict]].
*[[Parcelus Minor/Legends|Parcelus Minor]]&mdash;[[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]]&mdash;planet with explosive vegetation, was bombarded from orbit by CIS. The planet burned for a long time.
*[[Ruisto]]&mdash;[[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]]&mdash;[[Bombardment of Ruisto|Bombarded]] by the Galactic Empire. All life on the planet was wiped out.
*[[Uphrades]]&mdash;[[3643 BBY]]&mdash; Rendered uninhabitable by the [[Desolator (superweapon)|Desolator]] weapon during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].
*[[Tund/Legends|Tund]]&mdash;[[5 BBY/Legends|5 BBY]]&mdash;Rendered incapable of supporting life by [[Rokur Gepta]]'s [[electromagnetic torpedo]].
*[[Zarracina III]]&mdash;[[11,660 BBY]]&mdash;[[Bombardment of Zarracina III|Rendered uninhabitable]] by [[Pius Dea]] [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] forces during the [[Twelfth Pius Dea Crusade]].
*[[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]-[[3996 BBY]]-[[Force Light|Burned with the Force]] by the Jedi to defeat [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun]].<ref name="tsw6">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War 6|''Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War'' 6]]</ref>

===Inadvertent/accidental devastation===
*[[Clak'dor VII/Legends|Clak'dor VII]]&mdash;circa [[300 BBY/Legends|300 BBY]]&mdash;[[Bith/Legends|Bith]] chemical war rendered planet uninhabitable by Bith.
*[[Equanus]]&mdash;[[23 BBY/Legends|23 BBY]]&mdash;devastated when the Galactic Republic weapon testers tried a superweapon on a sun.
*[[Pammant/Legends|Pammant]]&mdash;[[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]&mdash;[[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] colony fractured to the core in a [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] accident with a Republic [[Battlecruiser/Legends|battlecruiser]].
*[[Seoul 5]]&mdash;accidental chain reaction of [[Seoularian crystal]]s destroyed the surface of the planet.
*[[Uba I]], [[Uba II|II]], and [[Uba V|V]]&mdash;[[1800 BBY]]&mdash;inadvertently irradiated by their own tactical weapons, triggered by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] during the [[New Sith Wars]]
*[[Varl/Legends|Varl]]&mdash;circa [[15,000 BBY/Legends|15,000 BBY]]&mdash;Planet devastated by either a supernova or a civil war among its [[Hutt/Legends|inhabitants]]
